scope: declared synthetic engineering contract; no physical or historical calibration; no acceptance yet
frame: physical millimetres, x right, y down; directed nib edge from fraction 0 to 1

tool.ink: constant adequate supply; no reservoir or optical compensation

tracks.interpolation: piecewise linear; unwrapped orientation; no duplicate progress

contact.lift: explicit event; no painted air connector
contact.edge_labels: 0 = negative directed nib endpoint, 1 = positive endpoint; labels survive frame reflection

geometry.reflection: y_down = -y_up, angle_down = -angle_up; directed endpoint fractions unchanged; polygon winding reverses
geometry.legacy: preserve legacy pixels in explicit legacy mode; finite-thickness new mode is a new contract, not silent reinterpretation

criteria.policy: predeclared engineering targets, not achieved performance; no posthoc relaxation; real gates require independent source calibration

comparisons: fixed vs rotation-only with fixed paths
full vs partial directed edge with fixed angle/path
explicit two-pass finishing overlap as separate structural comparison
required_negative_controls: centered shrink instead of shifted edge
undeclared lift or painted air connector
